name: The Moonlit Watcher
description: Once the camp is set up, Illuga should be able to rest for a while...

steps.description: Head to Illuga's home in Piramida

dialogs.content: Mission accomplished! Heh, looks like a whole new camp.
Yup! Even the fortifications are complete, too. Any attackers, be they monsters or otherwise, will have a hard time overcoming our defenses now.
The lighthouse has half a month's worth of fuel supplies, so even in the event of some massive Wild Hunt assault, we should be able to hold out until reinforcements arrive.
Thinking that far ahead, huh?
Haha, I just... It always pays to be prepared for the worst, y'know.
Either way, guess you can take a bit of a break now that it's all done.
Right, and that's why I'll be taking a trip home first. I mean, it's been a while since I've seen my old pops.
Home? Ohhh, yeah. Paimon's gotten so used to seeing you here, she almost forgot you're actually from Piramida.
Why don't you come along? If you wouldn't mind, I'd like to host you at our place.
We've set up a food truck here as per Paimon's suggestion, but cooking at home is more convenient all the same.
Ooh, so you'll be cooking? Well, you're in luck — 'cause Paimon never says no to a tasty meal!
Lakkaberry Krumkakes, Smoked Fish Steak, Berries and Fried Meat, and Nightwatch Soup... There's so much here — almost too much, even for Paimon!
Hmm... I made this according to the amount we'd usually cook for our troops at dinner. So yeah... it might be a bit much for three.
No worries, though, just take your time. I'll need to go see my old pops in a bit, so feel free to stay until evening.
Didn't realize you were such a talented chef!
Well, I did cook for everyone a lot before taking up my current post. It's just that I haven't had the time recently.
The people of Piramida come from every corner of the world, so there's a wide variety of palates to cater for. In other words, it pays to dabble.
But since I'm not yet familiar with your preferences, I just made a bit of everything. If there's anything here you particularly like, don't hesitate to say so.
If Paimon likes it, so do I.
What's that supposed to mean! Let's get this straight — Paimon's got her eye on the Berries and Fried Meat, so don't even try fighting her for that one!
Haha, you won't have to fight. I'll just make some more. Couldn't have my squadmates go hungry, could I?
People can say what they want, but the look on someone's face when they eat something they enjoy never lies.
As far as I'm concerned, nothing makes me happier than seeing people happy.
And whether as a Lightkeeper or a chef, I'll do whatever it takes to keep them smiling.
That might sound trivial to you, but deep down, that's all I've ever really wanted...
Hey, don't undersell yourself.
Exactly! There's no way the people around you aren't grateful for what you do. Heck, they'd probably get mad hearing you talk yourself down like that!
Besides, they'd have to get in line behind the two of us!
Thank you, hehe... Alright, I'll refrain from saying anything else unrelated to dinner. Please, enjoy your meal.
You're doing great as it is.
As long as you're making it, I'm a fan.
Heh, there's no need for flattery. If anything, that just makes me want to find the dish you'll like the most even more.
Don't worry, I think Paimon's got this.
Well of course, hehe, that goes without saying! Can't just let a good friend's efforts go to waste! Still, Paimon didn't expect you'd be such a good cook either, Illuga.
